### kernel-red-2 · Answer

Event: `6d9e46a95b1c3941cbae55b42c649869` · 2026-10-15T06:17:32Z

> Ruling (kernel-red-2). Read the alone log's smp=3 block, train 26's bench results, sched-capped's toml and program. The freeze stands until the evidence below is in.
> 
> What the rule can and cannot do here: in the `late` window three one-thread spinners hold three harts and nothing sleeps but the launcher's wait and C's SpinFrom wait: two or three payer-nowhere timeouts in 2 s. The oracle agrees: 3 to 6 interrupts charging another budget, 11-18k ticks, nothing against a 60 per mille loss (2.4M ticks). So the rule adds no work to A's hart and covers no sleepers' wakes there; what it changes is WHEN harts take interrupts, and the window's lock waits are 19.4M of 60M hart-ticks, a third of all hart time, under icount where a hart in a section keeps its turn. That is K31's trap: a 3-hart icount share read measures QEMU's turn order, and this clause has no host-clock twin at 3 (sched-capped-mttcg runs at smp 2 only). Three passes alone, one miss under load, then two misses of three after a change of a few interrupts is that sensitivity.
> 
> Evidence (idle2-implementer, scratch trees): (a) five alone runs each of rv64 sched-capped smp=3 on 146db8897 and 87553025a, same bundles: late-a/b/c and each budget's lock waits per run. (b) a temp sched-capped-mttcg with smp [2,3], five runs each on both commits on the quiet cores: late-a/b/c at 3 harts. (c) from the kept trace, per hart in the window: the I records' interrupted budget, every E/W/$ with its payer, any H 0 span, the Q waits with the holder's hart.
> 
> Decision: (b) passes near 333 on both and (a) fails only on IDLE2: IDLE2 moved the turn order, the fault is the case's 3-hart icount judging; the twin judges at 3 (smp [2,3], quiet class, five runs quoted), the icount case records there (hart_shares_from raised), a case change under K31, no bound widened, and IDLE2 merges with it. (b) fails on IDLE2 only: the rule is at fault; no merge until fixed. (a) fails on both: the clause was already broken; IDLE2 is cleared.
